info.title: finfy API
info.description: API of the finfy web app (route handlers in apps/web/app/api). Errors are stable codes in `error`; the client translates them (wiki/decisoes/0011). Authentication is a session cookie set by sign-in or e-mail verification.

tags.name: wallets
tags.description: Wallets and roles (wiki/decisoes/0002). Writes are idempotent by `mutationId` and audited

tags.name: accounts
tags.description: Accounts of a wallet; the balance is computed, never stored

session.name: finfy_session
session.description: HttpOnly session cookie. Named `__Host-finfy_session` in production.

post.description: **While e-mail delivery is off (now):** creates the account, starts a session (cookie) and answers `app`; an e-mail that already has an account gets `409 emailTaken`. **Once it is on:** always answers `verifyEmail`, whether or not the e-mail has an account, and e-mails a code (or a notice). The request must carry an `Origin` header equal to the app's origin; otherwise `403 forbiddenOrigin`.

400.description: Invalid input or password rule broken.

409.description: The e-mail already has an account (only while e-mail delivery is off).

429.description: Too many attempts. `Retry-After` header and `retryAfterSeconds` say when to try again.

post.summary: Sign in with e-mail and password
post.description: Starts a session (cookie) and answers `app`. Once e-mail delivery is on, an unverified account gets a new code and `verifyEmail` instead. The request must carry an `Origin` header equal to the app's origin; otherwise `403 forbiddenOrigin`.

400.description: Invalid input or password rule broken.

401.description: Wrong e-mail or password (never says which).

429.description: Too many attempts. `Retry-After` header and `retryAfterSeconds` say when to try again.

post.summary: Confirm the e-mailed code and start a session
post.description: **Off for now:** answers `404 unavailable` while there is no e-mail provider. 6 digits, valid 10 minutes, 5 tries. The request must carry an `Origin` header equal to the app's origin; otherwise `403 forbiddenOrigin`.

400.description: Invalid input or password rule broken.

429.description: Too many attempts. `Retry-After` header and `retryAfterSeconds` say when to try again.

post.description: **Off for now:** answers `404 unavailable` while there is no e-mail provider. Same answer whether or not the e-mail exists. The request must carry an `Origin` header equal to the app's origin; otherwise `403 forbiddenOrigin`.

400.description: Invalid input or password rule broken.

429.description: Too many attempts. `Retry-After` header and `retryAfterSeconds` say when to try again.

post.description: The request must carry an `Origin` header equal to the app's origin; otherwise `403 forbiddenOrigin`.

204.description: Signed out (also when there was no session).

get.summary: The user's active wallets, with their role

post.description: The client sends the wallet `id` and a `mutationId` (both UUIDs it generates). The creator becomes OWNER. Sending the same `mutationId` again returns the wallet without creating another. The request must carry an `Origin` header equal to the app's origin; otherwise `403 forbiddenOrigin`.

201.description: Created (or already created by this mutationId).

patch.description: OWNER or ADMIN. `baseVersion` is the version the client was editing. The name is free text: the last write wins and the old value stays in the audit log. The currency can only change before the first entry (`409 currencyLocked`) and only from the latest version (`409 versionConflict`). The request must carry an `Origin` header equal to the app's origin; otherwise `403 forbiddenOrigin`.

403.description: The member's role does not allow it. Wrong origin.

404.description: No such wallet, archived, or not a member.

409.description: The currency is fixed after the first entry. The wallet changed since `baseVersion`.

post.description: OWNER only, with the password again (step-up; 5 tries per 15 minutes). The wallet leaves every member's list; data and history are kept. The request must carry an `Origin` header equal to the app's origin; otherwise `403 forbiddenOrigin`.

403.description: The member's role does not allow it. Wrong origin.

404.description: No such wallet, archived, or not a member.

get.description: Any member. Main account first, then oldest first. `?archived=1` lists the archived ones. `balanceMinor` = `initialBalanceMinor` + paid, non-archived transactions of the account.

404.description: No such wallet, archived, or not a member.

post.description: OWNER, ADMIN, EDITOR. The client sends the account `id` and a `mutationId`. The wallet's first account becomes the main one; `isDefault: true` moves the mark. A non-zero initial balance locks the wallet's currency. The request must carry an `Origin` header equal to the app's origin; otherwise `403 forbiddenOrigin`.

201.description: Created (or already created by this mutationId).

403.description: The member's role does not allow it. Wrong origin.

404.description: No such wallet, archived, or not a member.

patch.description: OWNER, ADMIN, EDITOR. Name and color: the last write wins. Type and initial balance: only from the latest version (`409 versionConflict`). The request must carry an `Origin` header equal to the app's origin; otherwise `403 forbiddenOrigin`.

403.description: The member's role does not allow it. Wrong origin.

404.description: No such wallet, archived, or not a member.

post.description: OWNER, ADMIN, EDITOR. Its transactions are kept. If it was the main account, the oldest active account becomes the main one. The request must carry an `Origin` header equal to the app's origin; otherwise `403 forbiddenOrigin`.

403.description: The member's role does not allow it. Wrong origin.

404.description: No such wallet, archived, or not a member.

post.description: OWNER, ADMIN, EDITOR. It becomes the main account if the wallet has none. The request must carry an `Origin` header equal to the app's origin; otherwise `403 forbiddenOrigin`.

403.description: The member's role does not allow it. Wrong origin.

404.description: No such wallet, archived, or not a member.
